statement_refuted: After a rank-two Schur reduction, the existence of one residual row with leverage greater than one half forces a physical pair with a dimension-free positive Schur cross-volume certificate.
counterexample_scope: For even m and fixed 0<epsilon<1/2, the target-valid matrix A=[1] direct_sum S diag(1,-1) S^T has nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}, with S rows s_0=(sqrt(1-epsilon),0), s_r=(sqrt(epsilon/m),sigma_r/sqrt(m)) and half the sigma_r of each sign. The exact identity det(CC^T)=det(Gamma)^2 w_jk(1-c_j-c_k+w_jk) gives max physical-pair cross-volume O_epsilon(m^-1/2), hence it tends to zero.
repair: Condition the heavy physical row before whitening. The remaining cloud frame then has row leverage 2/m, and QFORM-CONDITION-ONE-HEAVY-ROW-v1 plus the completed account03/B01 diffuse-rank-two and dependence-safe-square theorems yields a uniform-in-m bound 2*3^(1/4)*sqrt(pi*e)*epsilon^(-1/4).
